newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ST Electronic & Engineering gets contract.
newsitem.headline: ST Electronic & Engineering gets contract.

text.p: ST Electronic & Engineering Ltd said on Tuesday it had clinched a Singapore $79.5 million government contract.
The company said a statement the contract is for a command and control system that would serve the Singapore Police Force, the Singapore Civil Defence Force and the Central Narcotics Bureau.
It involves the design, development and installation of a fully integrated real-time information management system.
The system will be deployed island-wide to cover all daily operations as well as resource management and planning.
ST Electronic & Engineering, the prime contractor, will design and develop the system with its partner Syseca SA, a subsidiary of Thomson CSF of France.
The system will be delivered in two phases in 1999 and 2000, the statement said.
